name: In The Groove

evidence.note: Band site calls its show 70s dance music and lists dance hits from the 70s to today.
Black Pearl show listing tells guests to bring their boogie shoes and get ready to groove.
Band's event page shows regular gigs at Black Pearl (Danford's, Port Jefferson) and Tiki Joe's.

dancing.notes: A disco and funk band built around dance music. Its shows are promoted as nights to bring your 'boogie shoes'.

description: A Long Island dance band that recreates 1970s disco and funk (Earth, Wind & Fire, Donna Summer) plus later dance hits.
genres: dance hits from the 70s to today
reviewNotes: Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Rated dance-band because the band markets itself around dance music; no evidence of partner or hustle dancing. Crowd video not watched.
